info.name: VOLTARAS Organization Service
info.description:
API tests for the VOLTARAS Organization Service.

SETUP
1. Start Eureka, Auth, User, Meter Reading, Organization, and the API Gateway (http://localhost:8080).
2. Register accounts via POST /api/auth/register (public route): consumer-a, consumer-b, consumer-c (CONSUMER) and system-admin (ADMIN).
3. Open the Organizations folder and run 'Login (Consumer-A)' and 'Login (System Admin)' first — the JWTs are stored automatically in the collection variables accessToken / adminAccessToken.
4. Run 'Create Organization (201)' to seed organizationId, then 'Create Building' / 'Create Block' / 'Create Floor' / 'Create Unit' in order to seed buildingId, blockId, floorId and unitId.

Do NOT add X-User-Id / X-User-Email / X-User-Role headers manually — the API Gateway validates the JWT and injects them automatically.

Folders: Organizations · Join Requests · Memberships · Buildings · Blocks · Floors · Units · System Admin · Negative Tests

Organization codes and structure codes use unique dynamic values ({{$guid}} / Date.now()) so the collection can be re-run without duplicate conflicts.
